description: r0b0tlab's SGLang native-MTP profile for RedHatAI's compressed-tensors NVFP4 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Apache-2.0; built-in MTP layer, no external draft) on one Spark, from r0b0tlab/qwen36-35b-a3b-nvfp4-gb10-native-mtp at c962efdf (the repository declares MIT for its scripts and docs). Runs the lmsysorg/sglang dev-cu13-nemotronh-nano-omni-reasoning-v3 image (pinned by the digest the tag resolved to on 2026-09-29; the tag was last pushed 2026-04-27, before upstream's 2026-05-19 evidence) with upstream's local loader fix baked in: the checkpoint stores the hybrid GDN linear-attention projections as plain unquantized weights, and stock SGLang produced repeated '!' tokens for it. Profile: FlashInfer CUTLASS FP4 GEMM and MoE, NEXTN with 1 step, top-1 and 2 draft tokens (built-in Qwen3_5ForCausalLMMTP), spec v2, radix cache and piecewise CUDA graph off, memory fraction 0.72, 4 running requests, 8,192-token context. Upstream claims (not measured here): correctness smoke 4/4, 57.49 tok/s single long decode, c1 61.49 / c2 97.87 / c4 174.69 tok/s, MTP accept length about 1.87 of 2. Bound to RedHatAI revision e850c696, the last one before upstream's evidence (later commits change only the model card). Physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B NVFP4 (RedHat AI) native MTP SGLang single Spark (r0b0tlab)
